messages.content: "假設您正在考慮在加州舊金山購買一棟房子。該房子建於1985年，佔地2000平方英呎，共有4間房間。您想要預測這棟房子的價格。在購買房子後，您還想了解前任屋主John Doe先生在舊金山涉及的任何訴訟。此外，您也想知道在一個可能的結果總數為1000且有5個有利結果的抽獎中獲勝的機率。您希望結果保留3位小數。請問您能提供預測的房價、John Doe先生在舊金山的訴訟情況，以及中獎機率嗎？"

function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Retrieve all lawsuits involving a particular entity from specified jurisdiction. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

county.description: The jurisdiction for the lawsuit search.

state.description: The state for the lawsuit search. Default is California.

function.name: calculate_probability
function.description: Calculate the probability of an event. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

round_to.description: Number of decimal places to round the result to.

function.name: predict_house_price
function.description: Predict house price based on area, number of rooms and year of construction. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

area.description: Area of the house in square feet.

rooms.description: Number of rooms in the house.

year.description: Year when the house was constructed.

location.description: The location or city of the house.

So call lawsuit_search with entity="John Doe", county="San Francisco"? But county might refer to county name; but they said "old San Francisco." In US, San Francisco is both city and county. We'll use county="San Francisco".

We need to specify state default CA so we can omit it.

Return results.

Also compute probability: total_outcomes=1000 favorable_outcomes=5 round_to=3. Use calculate_probability.

We'll produce JSON output containing predictions etc. We should not add extra text beyond JSON. According to instruction: Output only JSON object without markdown formatting. Should include predicted price, lawsuit info, probability.

First call predict_house_price. Then lawsuit_search. Then calculate_probability.
